english.note: Use this for a person who is composed and not anxious or angry; it is the all-purpose choice for emotional calm.
Use this when the emphasis is on staying calm and thinking clearly instead of being carried away by emotion.
Use this when the focus is on keeping control and not becoming emotionally agitated, especially in a tense situation.
Use 冷靜 for someone who remains calm and level-headed under pressure.
Use 冷靜 when someone remains calm and is not easily upset or excited.
Use 冷靜 when telling someone to stay calm and keep control of their emotions.

examples.traditional: 面對咁多問題，佢仲可以保持冷靜，逐樣諗清楚。
